# dsh-research-writing
Research writing bundle for DeepSeek Harness: literature search + citations + BibTeX cleanup + LaTeX
compile checks, in one install.
## What's inside
| Plugin | Tools |
| dsh-lit-search | `lit_search` / `lit_cite` / `lit_bib` / `lit_related` — Crossref + OpenAlex liter

ature search, GB/T 7714 / APA / BibTeX citations (incl. arXiv preprints) |
| dsh-latex-guard | `late
x_check` / `bib_lint` / `bib_fill` / `cite_audit` — latexmk compile checks with engine auto-detectio
n, BibTeX lint/fill, citation audit |
### Citation guide (new in 0.2.0)
The bundle now ships `skill/citation-guide.md`: a Chinese-language citation decision guide for under
graduate/novice paper writers — how many references to cite, which papers to prioritize (classics /
top venues / recent work), a three-round search strategy, GB/T 7714 ordering rules, footnote vs. end
note vs. bibliography, and a field-tested pitfall list. The bundle's SKILL.md points agents to it fo
r literature-review and reference-selection tasks.
### Journal whitelist (new in 0.3.0)
`data/journal-whitelist.json`: curated economics/management + computer science venue whitelist with
official sources and list versions (CSSCI 2025-2026, PKU Core 2023, CCF 2022, CAS journal divisions)
. Agents should check this file instead of guessing venue quality. `scripts/check-journal-lists.py`
re-checks official list versions quarterly (local use only).
